title: Record required merge lifecycle with exact head and merge commit
preconditions: Use CLI item cli with required primary merge unit and known 40-character head OID of ones and merge OID of twos.

steps.action: Record planned, then ready with parent planned/head OID, then integrated with parent ready, head OID and merge commit.
steps.expected_result: Every public mutation succeeds and integrated returns one event.

steps.action: Query work-events --kind merge for cli through every page and work-items for the item.
steps.expected_result: The required primary lifecycle is visible, integrated retains exact head/merge OIDs and parents, and evidence identifies the merge.

expected_result: Delivery remains attributable to immutable source and integration commits.
